label.en: Independent branches started by the origin

origin.3100.zh: 清除首都的废弃拱廊遗迹后：缓存
origin.3100.en: After clearing the ruined arcology blocker on the capital: Recovered Cache

origin.3101.zh: 在附近预设的理想行星上开始殖民：殖民地遗迹
origin.3101.en: On colonising a nearby prescripted ideal planet: Colonial Remains

opening.evidence: common/deposits/01_blocker_deposits.txt:1449 (d_ruined_arcology on_cleared, capital of a Remnants empire) fires origin.3100 (events/origin_events_3.txt:150-216, a random 0.95-progress research option); common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1274 on_colonization_started fires carrier event origin.3101 (events/origin_events_3.txt:217-267), adding colonial_remains, d_ruined_arcology and possibly a random blocker.

notes.zh: 选项给出“殖民地遗迹”修正与废弃拱廊矿藏，并随机增加一个（约一半概率）线索性障碍（放射性荒原、城市废墟等）。
notes.en: The option adds colonial_remains and d_ruined_arcology and, about half the time, a hint blocker chosen at random (radioactive wasteland, city ruins ...).

uncertain: The other empires' side (Colonial Remains is also used by Payback for MSI planets) is not part of this story.
